description: This Dart source file defines a CartProvider class used to manage shopping cart state within a Flutter application. It interacts with a CartService to perform CRUD operations on the cart and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based class that provides cart state management, including loading status, cart data, and methods to modify the cart via CartService.

methods.name: CartProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a CartService instance.

methods.name: cart
methods.description: Getter for the current Cart object.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Getter indicating whether an operation is currently in progress.

methods.name: totalAmount
methods.description: Getter for the total amount in the cart.

methods.name: itemCount
methods.description: Getter for the total number of items in the cart.

methods.name: loadCart
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the cart data from CartService.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a product to the cart with an optional quantity.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Asynchronously removes a product from the cart by productId.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the quantity of a specific product in the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Asynchronously clears all items from the cart.
